product_name: EYUVAA LABEL Vacuum Ultra Suction Magnetic Phone Holder for Car, Foldable Mobile Holder with Easy Secure Grip Compatible with Mag Saf Car Mount, Windshield, Dashboard, Mirror (with Arm)
description: Dual Axis Adjustment & 360° Rotation: This vacuum suction cup magnetic phone holder features a unique dual axis folding metal arm that can rotate both 360° horizontally and 210° vertically, making it easy to adjust any angle to meet your needs. Its unique folding design makes it unbelievably small in size. After 30000+ durability tests, it ensures stability and reliability. Strong Vacuum Suction: This vacuum suction phone mount adopts advanced rotating locking vacuum suction. You can easily achieve complete vacuum adsorption by gently rotating 120°. Compared with traditional suction cup phone mounts, the suction force is increased by 80% and does not require any adhesive. You no longer have to worry about leaving irremovable marks on your car windshield due to using a suction cup phone holder. Stronger Magnetic Force, One-Handed Operation: This magnetic phone holder uses military-grade ring-shaped N55 magnets, which are 200% stronger than standard magnets and provide top-level adsorption force. The precise magnetic design ensures strong adsorption without interfering with mobile phone signals, making navigation and calls clearer. Suitable for Various Types of Cars: You can easily install it on your car windshield or center console screen with one hand, or it can be paired with a glossy base (included) to install it on the car dashboard. Compact and portable, you can even put it in your pocket or bag, whether it's for fitness, office or travel. Wide Compatibility: Our magnetic car phone holder can be used directly on all Magnetic Mag Saf i Phones 16/15/14/13/12 and Pro Max mini-series. In addition, we offer metal rings for non-magnetic phones and phone cases. Glue the metal ring to the back of the phone or phone case and let it sit for 24 hours to maximize adhesion. [Warm Tips] Use the Included Adhesive Pad for smooth yet textured surfaces to ensure a secure mount. Avoid mounting on fluctuating or uneven surfaces. Use the Included Magnetic Ring for Non-Magnetic Phones and Phone Cases.
